verdict.rationale: Community users report using Gitea's built-in repository mirror feature to keep local copies of projects from other Git servers. That is direct evidence of inbound (pull) mirroring, but it rests only on community anecdotes, with no first-party documentation. missing for 10: outbound/push mirroring to another server, branch-level mirroring, first-party documentation of mirror configuration and sync scheduling.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can mirror repositories or branches to and from another Git server

citations.quote: Uses the repo mirroring feature to keep local copies of followed projects, which saved them when authors deleted repos.
The mirror feature keeps local copies of followed projects and saved them when authors deleted repos.
